crossRefs.note: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord…
Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv, that lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat…
“Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of…
Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Hear therefore Yahweh’s word, all you captives, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
translations.bsb: So hear the word of the LORD, all you exiles I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
translations.kjv: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
translations.asv: Hear ye therefore the word of Jehovah, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.
